detail.longDescription: This question asks the difference between import , __import__() and importlib.import_module() . However, it doesn't talk about importlib.__import__() . According to the docs : importlib. __import__ ( name , globals=None , locals=None , fromlist=() , level=0 ) An implementation of the built-in __import__() function. Note: Programmatic importing of modules should use import_module() instead of this function. Are importlib.__import__() and builtins.__import__() equivalent? What is "an implementation" of __import__() ?
